rules.title: Prompt injection: ignore previous instructions
rules.description: Classic instruction-override phrasing found in skill/prompt content.

rules.title: Prompt injection: disregard your instructions
rules.description: Attempts to make the agent drop its directives.

rules.title: Prompt injection: role override / new persona
rules.description: Forced persona switch in skill text.

rules.title: System-prompt exfiltration request
rules.description: Asks the agent to disclose its system prompt.

rules.title: Prompt injection: developer-mode / jailbreak toggle

rules.title: Invisible character: zero-width
rules.description: Zero-width chars can hide instructions from human review.

rules.title: Invisible character: tag characters (U+E0000 block)

rules.description: RTL/LTR isolates and overrides enable trojan-source style text rendering tricks.

rules.title: Variation selector used as hidden data channel

rules.title: ANSI escape sequence in prompt content

rules.title: Base64-encoded blob (possible payload obfuscation)
rules.description: Long base64 run — common way to hide injected instructions or C2 payloads.

rules.title: Base64 eval/exec of encoded string
rules.description: Decodes and immediately executes base64 data.

rules.title: Hex-encoded execution / long hex blob
rules.description: Long hex escape sequences or hex-decode-then-execute pattern.

rules.title: curl|bash remote code execution
rules.description: Pipes a remote script straight into a shell interpreter.

rules.title: curl/wget to /tmp then execute
rules.description: Downloads a binary into a temp path and executes it.

rules.title: pip install from direct URL (unpinned remote package)
rules.description: Installs a package from an arbitrary URL instead of a registry.

rules.title: npm install from direct URL/script
rules.description: Installs an npm package from an arbitrary URL.

rules.title: Reads SSH keys
rules.description: Accesses private SSH key material.

rules.title: Reads .env / secrets files
rules.description: Touches environment/credential files.

rules.title: Reads API tokens / keychains / password stores
rules.description: Extracts tokens, keychain entries or stored passwords.

rules.title: Reads browser/OS credential stores
rules.description: Touches browser profile DBs or OS keychain files.

rules.title: Exfil to pastebin-like paste service
rules.description: Sends data to an anonymous paste site.

rules.title: Exfil/tunnel via webhook or ngrok
rules.description: Webhook or reverse-tunnel endpoint used for data exfiltration or C2.

rules.title: Post/Upload of collected local data to remote host
rules.description: Uploads local data to a remote endpoint.

rules.title: Crypto miner: stratum protocol
rules.description: Cryptomining indicators.

rules.title: Crypto miner: known pool domains
rules.description: Connects to a mining pool.

rules.title: Persistence: crontab modification

rules.title: Persistence: systemd unit / launchd

rules.title: Persistence: shell rc / profile modification
rules.description: Appends commands to a user shell startup file.

rules.title: Persistence: SSH authorized_keys write

rules.description: Tool metadata carries instructions aimed at the agent.
